title: Highly Efficient Vertical Federated Clustering with Triangle-Inequality-based Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27117v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In many real-world scenarios, multiple parties hold complementary feature subsets for the same samples but cannot share raw data. This makes efficient clustering over distributed feature subsets an important and challenging problem. While vertical federated learning (VFL) enables such collaboration, existing VFL clustering methods often require many communication rounds or substantial local computation. To address these limitations, we first propose TriCD, an exact pruning method for CDKM that preserves the same cluster assignments under the same initialization. TriCD constructs triangle-inequality bounds on demand to skip redundant objective evaluations with negligible extra space. Building upon this, we propose FedTriCD, an efficient federated clustering algorithm. translated_title: 基于三角不等式剪枝的高效纵向联邦聚类
translated_abstract: 在许多现实场景中，多个参与方持有相同样本的不同特征子集，但无法共享原始数据，这使得在分布式特征子集上进行高效聚类成为一个重要且具有挑战性的问题。虽然纵向联邦学习（VFL）能够实现此类协作，但现有的VFL聚类方法通常需要大量的通信轮次或庞大的本地计算开销。为解决这些局限，我们首先提出了TriCD，这是一种针对CDKM的精确剪枝方法，在相同初始化条件下能够保持完全一致的聚类分配结果。TriCD按需构建三角不等式界，以跳过冗余的目标函数计算，且额外空间开销可以忽略不计。在此基础上，我们提出了高效的联邦聚类算法FedTriCD。通过将全局目标函数分解为客户端本地子问题，FedTriCD仅利用本地数据即可实现基于剪枝的本地优化。FedTriCD还进一步减少了通信开销（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于三角不等式的精确剪枝方法TriCD和高效联邦聚类算法FedTriCD，通过将全局目标分解为客户端本地子问题，在保证聚类结果一致的前提下显著减少了通信轮次与本地计算开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TriCD, an exact triangle-inequality-based pruning method for CDKM, and FedTriCD, an efficient federated clustering algorithm that decomposes the global objective into client-local subproblems, significantly reducing communication rounds and local computation while preserving identical cluster assignments.
